item.title: 【HD Live Performances】BDRiP - Girls Aloud - Tangled Up - Live from the O2 2008 (1080p HD)
item.description:
Girls Aloud - Tangled Up - Live from the O2 2008 (1080p HD)​


​
The Tangled Up Tour was the fourth concert tour by British all-female pop group Girls Aloud. It supported their fourth studio album Tangled Up. Tour dates were announced in November 2007. Girls Aloud performed twenty-four shows at arenas across the United Kingdom and Ireland, making this tour their third to reach arenas. The tour commenced in Belfast on 3 May 2008 and concluded in Birmingham on 4 June. Girls Aloud also performed eleven open air concerts over the summer.



More information: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tangled_Up_Tour

item.title: 【HD Live Performances】BDRiP - Mariah Carey - The Adventures of Mimi [Live from Anaheim] (1080p HD)
item.description:
Mariah Carey - The Adventures of Mimi [Live from Anaheim] (1080p HD)​


​
Mariah kicked off The Adventures Of Mimi tour, in support of her critically acclaimed album The Emancipation Of Mimi, with two shows in Tunisia in July 2006. The North American leg of the tour played thirty-two dates in the United States and Canada, before bringing Mariah to Japan, where she performed six additional dates. The October 6 concert in Anaheim, CA, was released on DVD and BluRay on November 16, 2007, featuring a surprise guest appearance by Boyz II Men, who joined Mariah to perform “One Sweet Day.”



More information: https://mariahcareynetwork.com/music/tour/taom.html

item.title: 【HD Live Performances】BDRiP - Mariah Carey - Daydream World Tour [Live at the Tokyo Dome] (1080p HD)
item.description:
Mariah Carey - Daydream World Tour [Live at the Tokyo Dome] (1080p HD)​


​
The "Daydream World Tour" was a concert tour by Mariah Carey in support of her platinum hit album Daydream. 150,000 tickets for her 3 Tokyo Dome concerts sold out in under 3 hours, making it the fastest selling show in the Tokyo Dome's history. The video on Blu-ray is available exclusively as a bonus disc in the Japanese special edition of her 2020 compilation album, The Rarities.



More information: https://mariahcareynetwork.com/music/live/tokyodome.html
